Chinese get their own community. And that means Germanic people, Nordic people, Celtic people etc. (white European ethnicities) also get their own place. They share a common language, common religion, a common culture, common values, and a common heritage. All “race” problems would be solved in a day if we organized in this way. Why is it racist to say all these other people can have their own place to live just for them with their own people and traditions, but if I want my own with my own people it’s an ethnostate? Because my skin is white? Being “white” does not even accurately represent all of the different cultures in European history, and my Germanic ethnicity is not the same as a Turkish ethnicity for example. I should have every right to a Germanic home that is for Germanic people just as much as the Indian has India, the Albanian has Albania, the Ghanaian has Ghana, or the Japanese has Japan. I want to live with and around people who have the same language, values, culture, and religion as me, not people who I have nothing in common with. Different cultures have different beauties about them that make them unique. I enjoy visiting them and learning about them. But they are not mine, and they never will be, and I do not want them in my home. | Will Witt

item.title: Immune cells flood into the aging brain, Stanford scientists discover
item.description: Scientists have discovered that the aging human brain may be far less isolated from the rest of the body than once believed. Stanford researchers found that large numbers of immune cells from the blood begin entering the brain as early as middle age, where they can transform into microglia, the brain’s specialized immune cells. The finding overturns a long-standing assumption that these cells remain largely separate from the body’s immune system throughout life. Fuente: ScienceDaily.
